title: Position-keyed deterministic and batch-invariant sampling
inspiration: DeepInfer batch-invariant inference; Qwen3.8 already uses Philox keyed by seed and token position.

delta.qwen38: No engine behavior change; add live serial/interleaving verification.
delta.qwen36: Replace mutable mt19937_64 host draws with the same position-keyed Philox contract.

evidence: qwen35_philox_test passes in the CUDA 13.1 120-real build; scripts/verify_determinism.mjs records SHA-256 hashes for serial and interleaved runs.
acceptance: For each tested seed and sampling configuration, all serial target hashes and all target hashes produced beside unrelated concurrent requests are identical.
rollback: Use the unpatched reference engine profile.
